seo.title: RSVP | Jeff & Paige
seo.description: RSVP for Jeff and Paige's wedding on August 5, 2028 at HollyHedge Estate in New Hope, PA.
seo.social_description: Let us know you'll be joining us for Jeff and Paige's wedding.

hero.label: Kindly Reply
hero.title: RSVP
hero.subtitle: We can't wait to celebrate with you. RSVPs will open when formal invitations go out.

closed_notice.title: Save the Date
closed_notice.text: We're still planning the details. Formal invitations — and this RSVP form — will go out closer to the day. For now, please mark your calendar!

extra_questions.afterparty_label: Will you join us at the after party?
extra_questions.wedding_song_hint: We'll play married guests' own wedding songs during cocktail hour. This isn't a dance-floor request; there's a spot for that further down.

thank_you.title: Thank You!
thank_you.text: We've received your RSVP. Jeff and Paige can't wait to celebrate with you.
